summary: Master the art of learning loops in MEAL Systems with our comprehensive training course. Elevate your evaluation skills and drive meaningful change.
lede: Learning loops in MEAL systems connect collected evidence with structured reflection and program adjustments. This course is for MEAL specialists, program managers, and other practitioners responsible for accountability or evidence-based programming who want to make insights actionable. It covers structuring reflection around program cycles, facilitating participatory feedback and review, and tracking how lessons inform adaptations and decisions.
audienceIntro: This training is designed for professionals committed to making data-driven decisions and fostering a culture of learning.
audience: Policy advisors using MEAL data for advocacy
modules: The Role of Learning in MEAL Systems
Measuring the Impact of Learning Loops
